text: {"overall_winner":"A","qualities":[{"evidence":"clear multi-paragraph structure","quality":"organization","description":"The essay presents ideas in a more coherent sequence with paragraphing that helps separate and develop its points."},{"evidence":"extended explanations of each point","quality":"development","description":"The essay more fully expands on its claims with supporting elaboration rather than brief or fragmentary treatment."},{"evidence":"fewer sentence-level disruptions","quality":"sentence control","description":"The essay shows better control of sentence construction, with fewer fragments and less frequent breakdowns in syntax."},{"evidence":"more consistent linking words like \"Although,\" \"Not only,\" and \"Because\"","quality":"cohesive devices","description":"The essay uses transitions and connectives more effectively to link ideas across sentences and paragraphs."},{"evidence":"generally understandable word choice despite errors","quality":"lexical clarity","description":"The essay uses vocabulary that more consistently communicates intended meaning without obscuring the message."},{"evidence":"comparatively smoother spelling and usage","quality":"conventions","description":"The essay has fewer severe spelling and word-form problems that interfere with reading."}]}
